actualSourceReview.invariant: Only an explicit current exact adopted property establishes purpose
actualSourceReview.observation: The key collection-purpose-v1 resolves a readable property Definition and sealed exact revision. Current component head, active lifecycle, notation, no successor and zero roles are checked. Selected Statements must pin that current revision and predicate, have acceptance, no applicability/interpretation definitions/qualification, and one of four exact untagged xsd:string values. No title, rdf:type or first-Statement heuristic supplies purpose.
actualSourceReview.evidence: Source inspection; retained statement/relation owner tests. Not a reproduced public API result.

actualSourceReview.invariant: Collection subject uses its actual membership owner
actualSourceReview.observation: Admission requires a readable native Collection, the current reading boundary, one active Collection Structure root and a collection-membership header whose owner and component equal the Collection. Public subject Statements can fall back from TargetNotBound/TargetUnavailable to that owner. It creates no generic Work or discussion capability revision.
actualSourceReview.evidence: Actual subject reader, structure/composition owners and public statements route were inspected; retained Collection-subject and retirement tests cover the owner path with substituted external transport.

actualSourceReview.invariant: Global adoption and complete absence are distinct from unavailable or ambiguous
actualSourceReview.observation: The finite property owner requires a real Global acceptance scope and seek owner, refuses corrupt coverage and forces a subject-and-predicate neighbourhood scan with 20-row batches. It ignores the enclosing generic cursor and uses an internal limit of two with visible lookahead. Only accepted candidates enter the result; proposals/wiki evidence alone, rejected/withdrawn or inactive Statements do not establish purpose. Zero disclosed eligible Statements after a completed scan yields null; duplicate visible claims, incomplete acceptance, invalid value, stale meaning or exhausted budgets refuse. It never selects an arbitrary first visible Statement.
actualSourceReview.evidence: Retained 65-proposal scan test, duplicate/invalid/unavailable/deadline tests and current acceptance resolver inspected. No real-stack bounded-load proof was run.

actualSourceReview.invariant: Hidden assertions do not supply ambiguity, value, citation or cursor state
actualSourceReview.observation: For finite selection, graph disclosure and reading visibility filter candidates before acceptance resolution. Context/Realm access then filters hydration before value/qualification/source interpretation and citation reads. Unavailable adoption is deferred until that visibility is established. Selection fences compare the disclosed purpose tuple or null rather than retaining raw hidden candidates. Internal raw scan positions are not returned by the purpose API. References and private Context access are rechecked before emission.
actualSourceReview.evidence: Source plus retained hidden/private malformed-value/source and changed-selection owner tests. These substitute graph/access/index transport and do not establish the six-persona public privacy outcome.

actualSourceReview.invariant: Sources and native command authorities stay independent
actualSourceReview.observation: An accepted directly authored Statement may return sources:[] or ordinary manual citations. Purpose reading adds no converter, mapper, retained-evidence or provider-identity prerequisite. Qualification validation reuses exact Definition guards; recording and Global decision adoption retain their original separate command/receipt identities. The new reader does not write or transform providers. Existing per-slot expected-head CAS, committed-request replay, rejection, withdrawal and idempotency conflict remain the owners of command semantics.
actualSourceReview.evidence: Actual command owner and new N3-backed transport-fixture tests inspected, including lost reply, stale/raced head and independent conflicting slots. Public command proof was not executed.

actualSourceReview.invariant: One relation contract for direct and embedded callers
actualSourceReview.observation: The direct route now passes boundary.session. The embedded page reader already passes its session. Both invoke the same traversal and purpose selection, with real Access/disclosure/reading gates and selected dependency/authority fences. Missing sessions now explicitly refuse Collection resolution. Both repaired fixtures supply native owner prerequisites; the restricted payload branch still throws, and their expected identities, next cursor, attempt count, source position and changed-counterpart fence assertions are preserved.
actualSourceReview.evidence: Actual routes/callers, parent and recovery diffs, retained direct/embedded and selected-owner test evidence; no public HTTP request was made.

actualSourceReview.invariant: Structural rendering preserves meaning and repeated membership identity
actualSourceReview.observation: Collection rendering has meaning:null, occurrence:null and actual structuralBasis {profile:collection-membership,collection,member}; role bindings use those resources. The five closed headings are Collections, Reading lists, Recipe selections, Series and Franchises. Fixed vocabulary retains recorded English language and explicit script/language fallback. No native relation Definition or repeated membership occurrence is fabricated. Existing DISTINCT incidence inventory remains one Collection edge; canonical Structure pages retain each occurrence, order and continuation, including repeated equal targets.
